name: Freight terminal
prompt: Generate ONE standalone landscape exterior concept render of a believable civilian orbital cargo station for an existing cozy hard-scifi cassette-futurist game. DO NOT use or imitate prior inspiration-folder images or the rejected tall spindle/tank/ring station. Fresh architecture guided by functional logistics. Refined block-built Blender/Godot game aesthetic, matte industrial enamel and metal, restrained bevels and readable panel detail, plausible scale, crisp lighting. No fantasy megastructure, ornamental clutter, weapons, neon, giant glass domes, mushroom tower or gratuitous ring. Full exterior visible with substantial negative space around silhouette, neutral black starfield and faint distant moon edge. Physics-aware assembly: pressurized modules with structural load paths, solar arrays for power and separate dark radiator surfaces, tanks insulated and segregated from living/docking, protected logistics spine, reaction-control pods modestly scaled. Docking approach volumes completely clear of booms/panels. Hangar outer dimensions ~55m long x30m wide x20m high with a 20m wide x12m high segmented CLOSED entry door and thick side pockets; internal clear volume can fit our roughly30m long boxy civilian Longhaul with rear cargo ramp, cargo-handling aisles, dispatch booth and storage connection. Hangar must look like a real volume with roof and sidewalls, not a door pasted onto a thin module. Main station roughly180-350m across, not a city. One small cream/gray rectangular freighter with vented aft engine pods, no wings, in foreground for scale, less than half hangar length, clear of entry. No text except sparse bay numbers. Space has no fog; readable illumination and gentle reflected fill, realistic material response without cinematic grime. Primary visual goal: structurally convincing station that was assembled for cargo operations; maintain game's cassette industrial character. This is design concept art, not claimed existing game screenshot. Design A: LOW WIDE FREIGHT TERMINAL. A strong flattened rectangular central warehouse pressure hull with chamfered corners, two full-depth hangar modules side by side integrated into the near edge, separated by a visible central service spine, wide sealed bay doors facing camera. Habitation/service blocks sit behind warehouse; loading and habitation volumes have credible depth and internal circulation links. Rear truss supports two broad solar wings and separate upright radiator banks behind approach plane, all firmly braced. Roof covered with sparse organized mechanical service blocks, not random towers. Palette warm off-white, muted brick red, charcoal. Camera three-quarter above frontal corner showing roofs, door faces and overall horizontal silhouette. No narrow spindle.
